post.title: How Recruiters Get Paid: The $16,000 Hire
post.ig:
One hire can pay a recruiter a $16,000 fee.
Contingency recruiters usually earn about 20-25% of first-year pay (SHRM, 2016). Our math: 20% of $80,000 = $16,000.
Retained executive search runs about 33%.
At Robert Half, candidates pay nothing, and placement fees were $440M of $5.38B revenue in FY2025.
Sources: SHRM (July 2016); Robert Half FY2025 Form 10-K.
News and education, not financial advice.
